title: "AWS Lambda w/Duck DB"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Build Lambda Function w/ECR

### ECR Repo

- Create repo

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr create-repository --repository-name test_duckdb --profile afrl --region us-east-2

```

#### DuckDB Test Lambda

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-2 --profile afrl | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com 

```
```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker build -t duckdb-tester -f Dockerfile.duckdb_test .

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker tag duckdb-tester:latest 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker push 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest

```

### Create Function

```{bash}

aws lambda create-function \
    --function-name duckdb-os-tester \
    --code ImageUri=650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest \
    --role arn:aws:iam::650251715690:role/afrl-lambda \
    --package-type Image \
    --publish \
    --timeout 900 \
    --memory-size 256 \
    --region us-east-2 \
    --profile afrl


```

### Update Function

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-2 --profile afrl | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com 

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker build -t duckdb-tester -f Dockerfile.duckdb_test .

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker tag duckdb-tester:latest 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker push 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws lambda update-function-code \
    --function-name duckdb-os-tester \
    --image-uri 650251715690.dkr.ecr.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/test_duckdb:latest \
    --publish \
    --region us-east-2 \
    --profile afrl

```
